declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.accept.eq_1
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {c : StrictLeanPolicy.Claim} {i : StrictLeanPolicy.Census} (p : StrictLeanPolicy.Plan c i)
  (roles : StrictLeanPolicy.Roles i.policy) (s : StrictLeanPolicy.ResultTable p),
  StrictLeanPolicy.accept p roles s =
    if hc : StrictLeanPolicy.CompleteFor p s then
      if hp : StrictLeanPolicy.AllPolicyOK p roles s then Except.ok { complete := hc, policy := hp }
      else Except.error StrictLeanPolicy.AcceptanceFailure.policyViolation
    else Except.error StrictLeanPolicy.AcceptanceFailure.incomplete

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.accepted_covers_slot
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {c : StrictLeanPolicy.Claim} {i : StrictLeanPolicy.Census} {p : StrictLeanPolicy.Plan c i}
  {roles : StrictLeanPolicy.Roles i.policy} {s : StrictLeanPolicy.ResultTable p}
  (a : StrictLeanPolicy.Accepted p roles s) (slot : Nat),
  slot < p.jobs.size →
    ∃ o,
      s.entries[slot]? = some o ∧
        p.jobs[slot]? = some o.key ∧
          StrictLeanPolicy.PolicyOK c i roles o ∧
            ∀ (other : StrictLeanPolicy.JobObservation), s.entries[slot]? = some other → other = o

declarations.name: _private.StrictLeanPolicy.Decision.0.StrictLeanPolicy.declarationFailure.eq_1
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ (decl : StrictLeanPolicy.Declaration) (native unsafeHelpers : Array Lean.Name)
  (profile : StrictLeanPolicy.ConformingProfile),
  StrictLeanPolicy.declarationFailure✝ decl (StrictLeanPolicy.InspectionRequest.conforming profile) native
      unsafeHelpers =
    if (decl.kind == StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationKind.axiom) = true then
      if native.contains decl.name = true then
        if
            (StrictLeanPolicy.InspectionRequest.conforming profile == StrictLeanPolicy.InspectionRequest.teaching) =
              true then
          none
        else some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.compilerTrusting
      else some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.projectAxiom
    else
      if decl.axioms.contains `sorryAx = true then some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.proofHole
      else
        if
            (decl.axioms.any fun name =>
                !StrictLeanPolicy.standardLogicalAxiom name && !StrictLeanPolicy.compilerAxiom✝ native name) =
              true then
          some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.unknownAxiom
        else
          if ((decl.isUnsafe || decl.isPartial) && !unsafeHelpers.contains decl.name) = true then
            some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.escapeHatch
          else
            if
                (decl.axioms.any (StrictLeanPolicy.compilerAxiom✝ native) &&
                    StrictLeanPolicy.InspectionRequest.conforming profile !=
                      StrictLeanPolicy.InspectionRequest.teaching) =
                  true then
              some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.compilerTrusting
            else
              if Option.any (fun x => x.failure.isSome) decl.executableContract = true then
                some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.executableContract
              else
                if
                    (decl.axioms.all fun name => StrictLeanPolicy.compilerAxiom✝ native name || profile.permits name) =
                      true then
                  none
                else some StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure.profileExceeded

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.admitNativeOrigin.eq_1
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ (moduleName : Lean.Name) (actual expected : String),
  StrictLeanPolicy.admitNativeOrigin moduleName actual expected =
    if hm : moduleName.getRoot = `Init then
      if hn : actual ≠ "" then
        if he : actual = expected then
          Except.ok
            { moduleName := moduleName, actual := actual, expected := expected, initModule := hm, nonempty := hn,
              agrees := he }
        else Except.error "native-runtime origin mismatch"
      else Except.error "empty native-runtime origin"
    else Except.error "native-runtime module is not Init"

declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {κ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Ord κ] [inst_1 : Std.TransOrd κ] [Std.LawfulEqOrd κ]
  {required : StrictLeanPolicy.CanonicalSet κ} {bound : κ → β → Prop} (s : StrictLeanPolicy.ResultState required bound)
  (k : κ) (v : β),
  k ∈ required →
    bound k v → ∀ (key : κ) (value : β), (s.entries.insert k v)[key]? = some value → key ∈ required ∧ bound key value

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.ResultState.insertResult.eq_1
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {κ : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : Ord κ] [inst_1 : Std.TransOrd κ] [inst_2 : Std.LawfulEqOrd κ]
  {required : StrictLeanPolicy.CanonicalSet κ} {bound : κ → β → Prop} [inst_3 : DecidableRel bound]
  (s : StrictLeanPolicy.ResultState required bound) (k : κ) (v : β),
  s.insertResult k v =
    if hk : k ∈ required then
      if s.entries[k]?.isSome = true then Except.error StrictLeanPolicy.AdmissionFailure.duplicateResult
      else
        if hb : bound k v then Except.ok { entries := s.entries.insert k v, valid := ⋯ }
        else Except.error StrictLeanPolicy.AdmissionFailure.invalidBinding
    else Except.error StrictLeanPolicy.AdmissionFailure.unknownKey

declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {κ : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : Ord κ] [inst_1 : Std.TransOrd κ] {required : StrictLeanPolicy.CanonicalSet κ}
  {bound : κ → β → Prop} [inst_2 : SizeOf κ] [inst_3 : SizeOf β] [inst_4 : (a : κ) → (a_1 : β) → SizeOf (bound a a_1)]
  (entries : Std.ExtTreeMap κ β compare) (valid : ∀ (k : κ) (v : β), entries[k]? = some v → k ∈ required ∧ bound k v),
  sizeOf { entries := entries, valid := valid } = 1 + sizeOf entries

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.ResultState.unknown_refused
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {κ : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : Ord κ] [inst_1 : Std.TransOrd κ] [inst_2 : Std.LawfulEqOrd κ]
  {required : StrictLeanPolicy.CanonicalSet κ} {bound : κ → β → Prop} [inst_3 : DecidableRel bound]
  (s : StrictLeanPolicy.ResultState required bound) (k : κ) (v : β),
  ¬k ∈ required → s.insertResult k v = Except.error StrictLeanPolicy.AdmissionFailure.unknownKey

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorKey.mk.inj
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ {role : StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorRole} {elaborator kind : Lean.Name} {role_1 : StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorRole}
  {elaborator_1 kind_1 : Lean.Name},
  { role := role, elaborator := elaborator, kind := kind } =
      { role := role_1, elaborator := elaborator_1, kind := kind_1 } →
    role = role_1 ∧ elaborator = elaborator_1 ∧ kind = kind_1

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorKey.mk.injEq
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ (role : StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorRole) (elaborator kind : Lean.Name) (role_1 : StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorRole)
  (elaborator_1 kind_1 : Lean.Name),
  ({ role := role, elaborator := elaborator, kind := kind } =
      { role := role_1, elaborator := elaborator_1, kind := kind_1 }) =
    (role = role_1 ∧ elaborator = elaborator_1 ∧ kind = kind_1)

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorKey.mk.sizeOf_spec
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ (role : StrictLeanPolicy.EvaluatorRole) (elaborator kind : Lean.Name),
  sizeOf { role := role, elaborator := elaborator, kind := kind } = 1 + sizeOf role + sizeOf elaborator + sizeOf kind

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision.brecOn
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀
  {motive :
    (a : List (StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure × Prop)) →
      (a_1 : Option StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure) → StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision a a_1 → Prop}
  {a : List (StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure × Prop)} {a_1 : Option StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure}
  (t : StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision a a_1),
  (∀ (a : List (StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure × Prop)) (a_2 : Option StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure)
      (t : StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision a a_2), StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision.below t → motive a a_2 t) →
    motive a a_1 t

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.orderedDecision_cons
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ (reason : StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure) (requirement : Prop)
  (rest : List (StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure × Prop)) (result : Option StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure),
  StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision ((reason, requirement) :: rest) result ↔
    ¬requirement ∧ result = some reason ∨ requirement ∧ StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision rest result

declarations.name: StrictLeanPolicy.orderedDecision_cons._simp_1
declarations.elaboratedType:
∀ (reason : StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure) (requirement : Prop)
  (rest : List (StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure × Prop)) (result : Option StrictLeanPolicy.DeclarationFailure),
  StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision ((reason, requirement) :: rest) result =
    (¬requirement ∧ result = some reason ∨ requirement ∧ StrictLeanPolicy.OrderedDecision rest result)
